user.title: Integration Manager
user.description: Manage owner-approved custom integrations and view their native entities. No credentials are required.

init.title: Release channels
init.description: The global channel is used by managed integrations. Integration Manager in Managed mode follows it, Default always uses Stable, and Override uses its own selected channel.

data.channel: Override release channel (used only in Override mode)

restart_required.title: Home Assistant restart required
restart_required.description: Integration files or configuration changed. Restart Home Assistant to activate the changes. Use Fix issue to confirm a restart.

confirm_restart.title: Restart Home Assistant?
confirm_restart.description: Restart Home Assistant now to activate Integration Manager changes. Active automations will be interrupted.

error.operation_in_progress: Wait for the current integration operation to finish.
error.restart_failed: Home Assistant could not restart. Inspect its logs and try again.

abort.restart_requested: Restart requested. This issue remains until the new runtime is active.
abort.no_restart_required: A restart is no longer required.
